enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +12: Passive: +12 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

This painful curse also causes the victim to take 2d6 damage every two seconds for a duration of twelve seconds. Additional vorpal strikes while the curse is active will extend the duration by another twelve seconds.

Necromancy Focus +1: +1 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
